paras: Flexiseps crenni is a species of skink, a lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to Madagascar.
The specific name, crenni, is in honor of ophthalmologist Louis Crenn, who presented the holotype to Mocquard.
The preferred natural habitat of F. crenni is forest.
F. crenni has very short legs with a reduced number of digits. Each front foot has 2–3 digits, and each back foot has 2–4 digits. The holotype has a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 11.5 cm (4.5 in).
The mode of reproduction of F. crenni is unknown.
